target.title: fix(acp): guard child process pipe stream errors in createAcpClient
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`createAcpClient` spawns an ACP server with `stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "inherit"]` but registered no `error` listeners on the child stdout, stdin, or process. An EPIPE or stream error on either pipe would trigger an unhandled `error` event, crashing the host Node process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added three `on("error")` handlers in `createAcpClient`:
- `agent.stdout.on("error", ...)` — guards stdout read pipe
- `agent.stdin.on("error", ...)` — guards stdin write pipe
- `agent.on("error", ...)` — guards spawn-level failures (ENOENT etc.)

Same pattern as grep.ts (#101014), find.ts, bash tool, ssh sandbox.

## User Impact

No behavioral change for normal ACP sessions. Stream errors now log to stderr (in verbose mode) instead of crashing the gateway.

## Evidence

### (a) Negative control — unhandled stream error crashes Node.js

`PassThrough` without an `error` listener throws on `emit("error", ...)`. This is the Node.js default that `createAcpClient` must guard against.

```text
 ✓ ACP client stream errors > bug: PassThrough emits unhandled error → process crash (stdout)
 ✓ ACP client stream errors > bug: PassThrough emits unhandled error → process crash (stdin)
```

### (b) Fix applied — registered error handler prevents crash (5 invariants)

```text
 ✓ fix: registered error listener on stdout prevents crash
 ✓ fix: registered error listener on stdin prevents crash
 ✓ fix: process error listener prevents crash
 ✓ handles simultaneous stdout+stdin errors
 ✓ handles late error after stream closed

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
```

### (c) Production handlers — 3 error listeners on spawned child

```
src/acp/client.ts:156:  const onStreamError = (label, err) => { ... }
src/acp/client.ts:159:  agent.stdout.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("stdout", err));
src/acp/client.ts:160:  agent.stdin.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("stdin", err));
src/acp/client.ts:161:  agent.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("spawn", err));
```

`npx oxlint src/acp/client.ts` — 0 errors, 0 warnings
